entries.scene: Da Wialo Kallai Afghan village, the EXACT distinctive two-storey weathered pale stone and white plaster outpost building in the screenshot: flat sandbagged rooftop, rooftop satellite dish, narrow black rectangular upper windows, shaded ground-level fabric awning, arch passage to its side, simple red Soviet flag on a thin pole to the left and low stone walls. Surround with the attested dry rocky tan slopes, sparse dull olive small trees and adjoining low flat-roof stone dwellings. Use the central building as the dominant background landmark, not a random mosque. Bright dry daylight, desaturated sand/grey/olive palette. Turn the village forecourt into a flat side-on foreground road.
